name: The Road
notes: The genre's nameless traveller. A solid charcoal cape is the silhouette from behind and at the sides; a tattered one at this size read as speckle. Colours are dusk16's own - moss, indigo, leather, stone. He swings a bronze arming sword in the arena, and only there: the sword is drawn in the slash alone, so he walks the village unarmed and his portrait holds no blade. Bronze, to match the Bronze sword he can buy. The generator draws its swing on 128px frames in a block below the sheet, which the composer records and the importer crops to what it draws.
